latin: Si dictum illud Prophetae: Vendiderunt iustum argento, cabalistice exponamus, nihil aliud nobis significat quam hoc, scilicet, Deus ut redemptor uenditus fuit argento.
translation: If we explain that saying of the Prophet, They sold the just man for silver, in the Cabalistic manner, it signifies to us nothing other than this: that God, as redeemer, was sold for silver.
translation_note: The verse is Amos 2:6, read through Matt. 26:14-16 (farmer1998:26833); 'iustus' and 'redemptor' are, on Farmer's note, standing names for the ninth sefirah, the same pairing taken up again in 11>21 (farmer1998:26833).
